results.title: GLEIF (Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation)
results.snippet: The Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation (GLEIF) is a non-profit organisation founded in Basel, Switzerland in 2014 that oversees the global system for issuing and managing Legal Entity Identifiers (LEIs).

results.title: GLEIF Database Explained - How Global LEI Data Works
results.snippet: GLEIF Database Explained - How Global LEI Data Works Quick Answer The GLEIF database is the central repository of all Legal Entity Identifiers worldwide, operated by the Global Legal Entity Identifier Foundation. It contains 2.7M+ LEI records with two layers of data: Level 1 ("who is who") and Level 2 ("who owns whom").
